0x000000018d9cb348  0x00000168  __TEXT,__text  objc  -[CIBilateralSolverGPU .cxx_destruct]  // -[CIBilateralSolverGPU ec2 center, vec2 skew_to_unit, vec2 unit_to_skew, float sqrt3inv) {
  vec2 t0 = destCoord() - center;
  vec2 t0_skewed = t0;
  t0_skewed.x -= t0_skewed.y * sqrt3inv;
  vec2 t0_unit = t0_skewed * skew_to_unit;
  vec2 t0_slot = floor(t0_unit);
  vec2 t0_offset = t0_unit - t0_slot;
  vec2 t0_base = t0_slot * unit_to_skew;
  vec2 p0 = t0_base;
  vec2 p1 = t0_base;
  p1.y = p1.y + unit_to_skew.y;
  vec2 p2 = t0_base;
  p2.x = p2.x + unit_to_skew.x;
  vec2 p3 = t0_base + unit_to_skew;
  p0 = compare(vec2((t0_offset.x + t0_offset.y) - 1.0), p0, p3);
  p0.x += p0.y * sqrt3inv;
  p1.x += p1.y * sqrt3inv;
  p2.x += p2.y * sqrt3inv;
  vec2 d0 = t0 - p0;
  d0 = d0 * d0;
  float d1 = d0.x + d0.y;
  vec3 s0 = vec3(p0, d1 * inversesqrt(d1));
  d0 = t0 - p1;
  d0 = d0 * d0;
  d1 = d0.x + d0.y;
  vec3 s1 = vec3(p1, d1 * inversesqrt(d1));
  d0 = t0 - p2;
  d0 = d0 * d0;
  d1 = d0.x + d0.y;
  vec3 s2 = vec3(p2, d1 * inversesqrt(d1));
  vec3 desc = vec3(s0.z - s1.z);
  vec3 s3 = compare(desc, s0, s1);
  vec3 s4 = compare(desc, s1, s0);
  desc = vec3(s3.z - s4.z);
  vec3 s5 = compare(desc, s3, s2);
  vec3 s6 = compare(desc, s2, s3);
  desc = vec3(s4.z - s6.z);
  vec3 s7 = compare(desc, s4, s6);
  vec4 c0 = sample(src, samplerTransform(src, s5.xy + center));
  vec4 c1 = sample(src, samplerTransform(src, s7.xy + center));
  return mix(c0, c1, clamp(((s5.z - s7.z) * 0.5) + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0));
}

// Simulate a GLSL 4.00+ textureGather call
// xyzw in counter clockwise order, starting with the sample to the lower left of the queried location

#define _samplerOffset(src, offset) (samplerTransform(src,offset) - samplerTransform(src,vec2(0.0)))

//TODO: Need to snap 'point' to nearest 2x2 pixel grid center, since samplers may not be using nearest filtering.

vec4 gatherX (sampler src, vec2 point)
{
    vec4 r = vec4(
        sample(src, point+_samplerOffset(src,vec2(-0.5,-0.5))).x,
        sample(src, point+_samplerOffset(src,vec2( 0.5,-0.5))).x,
        sample(src, point+_samplerOffset(src,vec2( 0.5, 0.5))).x,
        sample(src, point+_samplerOffset(src,vec2(-0.5, 0.5))).x);
    return r;
}

vec4 gatherY (sampler src, vec2 point)
{
    vec4 r = vec4(
        sample(src, point+_samplerOffset(src,vec2(-0.5,-0.5))).y,
        sample(src, point+_samplerOffset(src,vec2( 0.5,-0.5))).y,
        sample(src, point+_samplerOffset(src,vec2( 0.5, 0.5))).y,
        sample(src, point+_samplerOffset(src,vec2(-0.5, 0.5))).y);
    return r;
}

vec4 gatherZ (sampler src, vec2 point)
{
    vec4 r = vec4(
        sample(src, point+_samplerOffset(src,vec2(-0.5,-0.5))).z,
        sample(src, point+_samplerOffset(src,vec2( 0.5,-0.5))).z,
        sample(src, point+_samplerOffset(src,vec2( 0.5, 0.5))).z,
        sample(src, point+_samplerOffset(src,vec2(-0.5, 0.5))).z);
    return r;
}

vec4 gatherW (sampler src, vec2 point)
{
    vec4 r = vec4(
        sample(src, point+_samplerOffset(src,vec2(-0.5,-0.5))).w,
        sample(src, point+_samplerOffset(src,vec2( 0.5,-0.5))).w,
        sample(src, point+_samplerOffset(src,vec2( 0.5, 0.5))).w,
        sample(src, point+_samplerOffset(src,vec2(-0.5, 0.5))).w);
    return r;
}

#define _unordered_gatherY(src, point) gatherY(src, point)
#define _unordered_gatherZ(src, point) gatherZ(src, point)
#define _unordered_gatherW(src, point) gatherW(src, point)

#define samplerOrigin(src) samplerExtent(src).xy

    float relativeWeight = rwT * rwT * (3.0 - 2.0 * rwT); 
    float totalWeight = distWeight * spatialWeight * colorWeight * backgroundWeight * relativeWeight;
    return vec4( totalWeight * sampledPix.xyz, totalWeight );
}
float _ushortMultiply(float a,float multiplier) {
   int q = int(a) * int(multiplier);
   int r = q/65536;
   int m = q - r * 65536;
   float mf = float(m);
   return mf + compare(mf, 65535.0, 0.0);
}
kernel vec4 _CIPortraitBlur(sampler image,vec4 sizeAndScale,vec3 p0,vec4 p1,vec2 relativeWeightThreshold) 
{
   float maxBlurInPixels         = p0.x;
   float sharpRadius             = p0.y;
   float highlightBoostGain      = p0.z;
   vec2 spatialWeightSoftMinMax  = p1.xy;
   float basePixelWeight         = p1.z;
   int numSamples                = int(p1.w);
    vec2 dc = destCoord();
    vec4 basePix = sample(image, samplerCoord(image));
    float rawBlurRadius = basePix.w * basePix.w;
    float blurRadius = rawBlurRadius * maxBlurInPixels;
    vec4 outRGB;
    if ( blurRadius >= sharpRadius )
    {
      vec4 pixSum = vec4(basePix.xyz * basePixelWeight, basePixelWeight);
	   vec2 randXY = _pseudo_randPBN(dc/sizeAndScale.xy) * sizeAndScale.zw * 65536.0;
      for ( int i = 0; i < numSamples; i++ )
      {
           vec2 randXY2 = (1./32767.5) * randXY - 1.0; 
           float randDist = randXY2.x*randXY2.x + randXY2.y*randXY2.y;
           float randNorm0 = max(abs(randXY2.x),abs(randXY2.y));
           float randShape = randNorm0 / sqrt(randDist);
           vec2  samplePos = randShape * rawBlurRadius * randXY2;
           float randW = randShape * randShape;
           samplePos.y = -samplePos.y;
           randXY.x = _ushortMultiply(randXY.x, 28563.0);
           randXY.y = _ushortMultiply(randXY.y, 44519.0);
	        vec4 pix = sample( image, samplerTransform(image, dc + maxBlurInPixels * samplePos));
           pix.w = pix.w * pix.w;
           pixSum += _pixWeight(pix, samplePos, rawBlurRadius, randW, spatialWeightSoftMinMax, highlightBoostGain, relativeWeightThreshold);
        }
        outRGB.xyz = pixSum.w > 0.0 ?  vec3(pixSum.xyz / pixSum.w) : basePix.xyz;
        outRGB.w = basePix.w;
    }
    else
    {
        outRGB = basePix;
    }
	return outRGB;
}

  vec4 q8 = sample(src, samplerTransform(src, d + offset23.zw));
  vec4 q9 = sample(src, samplerTransform(src, d + offset4.xy));
  return ((((weight.x * (q4 + q5)) + (weight.y * (q3 + q6))) + (weight.z * (q2 + q7))) + (weight.w * (q1 + q8))) + (weight2.x * (q0 + q9));
}

  vec2 dc1 = (uv1 * ext.zw) + ext.xy;
  vec2 dc2 = (uv2 * ext.zw) + ext.xy;
  return distance(dc1, dc2);
}
kernel vec4 _distanceMask(sampler image, vec4 ext, float stride) {
  float minDist = 1.000000e+09;
  const float nan = 1.0 / 0.0;
  vec4 result = vec4(nan, nan, 0.0, 1.0);
  vec2 dc = destCoord();
  vec2 uv = _dc_to_uv(dc, ext);
  for (int i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
    for (int j = -1; j <= 1; j++) {
      vec2 off = vec2(i, j) * stride;
      vec4 s = sample(image, samplerTransform(image, dc + off));
      if (s.r == nan) continue;
      float dist = _uv_distance(s.xy, uv, ext);
      if (dist < minDist) {
        result = s;
        minDist = dist;
      }
    }
  }
  return result;
}

using namespace metal;
#define KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(destTransform) destTransform[3].xy
#define KERNEL_THREAD_COUNT(destTransform) static_cast<uint2>(destTransform[3].zw)
#define CI_ALWAYS_INLINE __attribute__((always_inline))
static float2 _affineTransform(float4x4 m, float2 p)
{
    return float2(dot(float3(p,1.0), m[0].xyz),
                  dot(float3(p,1.0), m[1].xyz));
}
#ifndef _BUILDING_CORE_IMAGE_LIB_ //[
template <typename T, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE T4 _read_pixel(texture2d<T, access::sample> image, sampler s, float2 p, float3x3 transform)
{
    float3 loc = float3(p, 1.0) * transform;
    return image.sample(s, loc.xy);
}
template <typename T, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE T4 _read_pixel_420(texture2d<T, access::sample> Y, sampler sY, float2 p, float3x3 transform,
                                    texture2d<T, access::sample> CC, sampler sCC, float2 f)
{
    float3 loc = float3(p, 1.0) * transform;
    return T4(Y.sample(sY, loc.xy).r, CC.sample(sCC, f*loc.xy).rg, 1.0);
}
template <typename T, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE T4 _read_pixel_420_r_rg(texture2d<T, access::sample> Y, sampler sY, float2 p, float3x3 transform,
                                         texture2d<T, access::sample> CC, sampler sCC, float2 f)
{
    float3 loc = float3(p, 1.0) * transform;
    return T4(Y.sample(sY, loc.xy).r, CC.sample(sCC, f*loc.xy).rg, 1.0);
}
// The biplanar packed 10-bit 420 format 'pf20' and 'p420' combine the horizontally neighboring luma
// values in one 32-bit word for the luma plane.  We bind this format at RGB10A2 as it aligns with how
// they do this.  This code is used to index and pull out the right value.  For the Chroma it is a bit
// more complex as three pairs of CrCb are packed into two 32-bit words and the second one straddles
// two samples.
//TODO check that a scaled image is getting the chroma correctly interpolated
//TODO handle the left and right edges for the chroma
template <typename T, typename T2, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE T4 _read_pixel_420_packed(texture2d<T, access::sample> Y,  sampler sY,  float2 c, float3x3 transform,
                                           texture2d<T, access::sample> CC, sampler sCC, float2 f)
{
    int cInt = int(c.x);
    int cInt2 = int(c.x*0.5);
    int lumaX = cInt/3;
    float3 pLuma = float3(lumaX+0.5, c.y, 1.0) * transform;
    int chromaX = (cInt2/3)*2;
    float3 pChromaM1 = float3(2.0*(chromaX - 0.5), c.y, 1.0) * transform;
    float3 pChroma1 = float3(2.0*(chromaX + 0.5), c.y, 1.0) * transform;
    float3 pChroma2 = float3(2.0*(chromaX + 1.5), c.y, 1.0) * transform;
    float3 pChroma3 = float3(2.0*(chromaX + 2.5), c.y, 1.0) * transform;
    T4 lumaGroup = Y.sample(sY, pLuma.xy);
    T4 chromaM1 = CC.sample(sCC, pChromaM1.xy * f);
    T4 chroma1 = CC.sample(sCC, pChroma1.xy * f);
    T4 chroma2 = CC.sample(sCC, pChroma2.xy * f);
    T4 chroma3 = CC.sample(sCC, pChroma3.xy * f);
    T2 crcbM1 = chromaM1.yx;
    T2 crcb0 = chroma1.zy;
    T2 crcb1 = T2(chroma1.x,chroma2.z);
    T2 crcb2 = chroma2.yx;
    T2 crcb3 = chroma3.zy;
    T4 out = T4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    int lumaRemainder = cInt - lumaX*3;
    out.x = (lumaRemainder==0) ? lumaGroup.z : (lumaRemainder==1) ? lumaGroup.y : lumaGroup.x;
    //Perform the chroma interpolation
    int chromaRemainder = cInt - (cInt/6)*6;  // dont use  % operator
    if (chromaRemainder == 0){
        out.yz = mix(crcbM1, crcb0, 0.75);
    } else if (chromaRemainder == 1) {
        out.yz = mix(crcb0, crcb1, 0.25);
    } else if (chromaRemainder == 2) {
        out.yz = mix(crcb0, crcb1, 0.75);
    } else if (chromaRemainder == 3) {
        out.yz = mix(crcb1, crcb2, 0.25);
    } else if (chromaRemainder == 4) {
        out.yz = mix(crcb1, crcb2, 0.75);
    } else if (chromaRemainder == 5) {
        out.yz = mix(crcb2, crcb3, 0.25);
    }
    return out;
}
#endif //] _BUILDING_CORE_IMAGE_LIB_
template <typename T, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE void _write_pixel(texture2d<T, access::write> outputTexture, const T4 result, const uint2 gid, const float4 outputRect)
{
    uint2 loc = gid + static_cast<uint2>(outputRect.xy);
    loc.y = loc.y + lessThan(outputRect.w, 0) * ((-outputRect.w-1)-2*gid.y); // for 'needsVerticalFlip'
    outputTexture.write(result, loc);
}
template <typename T, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE void _destinationWrite(texture2d<T, access::write> t, float4x4 m, float4 r, T4 v, float2 dc)
{
    const float2 p = _affineTransform(m, dc);
    const uint2 gid = static_cast<uint2>(p - r.xy); // assuming p >= r.xy
    if (all(gid < static_cast<uint2>(abs(r.zw))))
    {
        _write_pixel<T,T4>(t, v, gid, r);
    }
}

    static float4 _samplerExtent(float4x4 m)
    {
        return m[3]; // extent packed in last (unused) row of 4x4 transform matrix
    }
#ifdef __CIKERNEL_METAL_SUPPORTS_GATHER__ //[
    static half2 _gatherTransform(half2x2 m, half2 p)
    {
        return p * m + 0.5;
    }
    #define GATHER_COORD_TO_IDX(p) short(p.x + p.y * 2)
    template <typename T>
    static T _gatherOrdered(float4x4 m, T v)
    {
        // reorder samples into linear buffer based on Metal's specified order of gathered samples: v[0] v[1]
        v = v.wzxy; //                                                                              v[2] v[3]
        // reduce transform to orientation matrix for unit extent of [-0.5 -0.5 1 1], centered about the origin
        half2x2 orientation = half2x2(sign(m[0][0]),sign(m[0][1]),
                                      sign(m[1][0]),sign(m[1][1]));
        // transform gather coords based on sampler transform
        half2 p00 = _gatherTransform(orientation, half2(-0.5,-0.5));
        half2 p10 = _gatherTransform(orientation, half2( 0.5,-0.5));
        half2 p11 = _gatherTransform(orientation, half2( 0.5, 0.5));
        half2 p01 = _gatherTransform(orientation, half2(-0.5, 0.5));
        // convert gather coords to buffer indices, and return samples in CCW order starting w/ sample at the lower left
        return T(v[GATHER_COORD_TO_IDX(p00)],
                 v[GATHER_COORD_TO_IDX(p10)],
                 v[GATHER_COORD_TO_IDX(p11)],
                 v[GATHER_COORD_TO_IDX(p01)]);
    }
#endif //] __CIKERNEL_METAL_SUPPORTS_GATHER__

    // Returns the position, in sampler space, of the sampler that is associated with the current output pixel (that is, after any transformation matrix
    // associated with sampler is applied). The sample space refers to the coordinate space of that you are texturing from. Note that if your source data is tiled,
    // the sample coordinate will have an offset (dx/dy). You can convert a destination location to the sampler location using the transform function.
    float2 sampler::coord() const
    {
        return transform(dc);
    }
    // Returns the extent of the sampler in world coordinates, as a four-element vector [x, y, width, height].
    float4 sampler::extent() const
    {

    namespace group
    {
        // Writes 4 color values to the destination texture for the current 2x2 group of pixels.
        void destination::write(float4 v0, float4 v1, float4 v2, float4 v3)
        {
#if __CIKERNEL_SUPPORTS_VARIABLE_GROUPSIZE__
            float4x4 v = float4x4(v0, v1, v2, v3);
            for (short i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            {
                short dx = i % short(KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(m).x);
                short dy = i / short(KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(m).y);
                _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v[i], c + float2(dx,dy));
            }
#else
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v0, c);
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v1, c + float2(1,0));
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v2, c + float2(0,1));
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v3, c + float2(1,1));
#endif
        }
        // Writes 4 color values to the destination texture for the current 2x2 group of pixels.
        void destination_h::write(half4 v0, half4 v1, half4 v2, half4 v3)
        {
#if __CIKERNEL_SUPPORTS_VARIABLE_GROUPSIZE__
            half4x4 v = half4x4(v0, v1, v2, v3);
            for (short i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            {
                short dx = i % short(KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(m).x);
                short dy = i / short(KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(m).y);
                _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v[i], c + float2(dx,dy));
            }
#else
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v0, c);
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v1, c + float2(1,0));
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v2, c + float2(0,1));
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v3, c + float2(1,1));
#endif
        }
    }
#pragma mark - math
    float4 premultiply(float4 s) { return float4(s.xyz* s.w, s.w); }
    half4 premultiply(half4 s) { return half4(s.xyz* s.w, s.w); }
    float4 unpremultiply(float4 s) { return float4(s.xyz/ fmax(s.w, 0.00001), s.w); }
    half4 unpremultiply(half4 s) { return half4(s.xyz/ fmax(s.w, 0.0001h), s.w); }
    #define _srgb_to_linear(s,t) sign(s) * mix(abs(s)*0.077399380804954##t, pow(abs(s)*0.947867298578199##t + 0.052132701421801##t, 2.4##t), step(0.04045##t, abs(s)))
    float3 srgb_to_linear(float3 s) { return _srgb_to_linear(s, f); }
    half3 srgb_to_linear(half3 s) { return _srgb_to_linear(s, h); }
    float4 srgb_to_linear(float4 s)
    {
        s = float4(unpremultiply(s));
        s.rgb = _srgb_to_linear(s.rgb, f);
        return premultiply(s);
    }
    half4 srgb_to_linear(half4 s)
    {
        s = half4(unpremultiply(s));
        s.rgb = _srgb_to_linear(s.rgb, h);
        return premultiply(s);
    }
    #define _linear_to_srgb(s,t) sign(s) * mix(abs(s)*12.92##t, pow(abs(s), 0.4166667##t) * 1.055##t - 0.055##t, step(0.0031308##t, abs(s)))
    float3 linear_to_srgb(float3 s) { return _linear_to_srgb(s, f); }
    half3 linear_to_srgb(half3 s) { return _linear_to_srgb(s, h); }
    float4 linear_to_srgb(float4 s)
    {
      s = float4(unpremultiply(s));
      s.rgb = _linear_to_srgb(s.rgb, f);
      return premultiply(s);
    }
    half4 linear_to_srgb(half4 s)
    {
      s = half4(unpremultiply(s));
      s.rgb = _linear_to_srgb(s.rgb, h);
      return premultiply(s);
    }
    #define _compare(x,y,z) select(z, y, signbit(x)) // for each component, returns x < 0 ? y : z
    float  compare(float  x, float  y, float  z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    float2 compare(float2 x, float2 y, float2 z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    float3 compare(float3 x, float3 y, float3 z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    float4 compare(float4 x, float4 y, float4 z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    half   compare(half   x, half   y, half   z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    half2  compare(half2  x, half2  y, half2  z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    half3  compare(half3  x, half3  y, half3  z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    half4  compare(half4  x, half4  y, half4  z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    float2 cossin(float x)
    {
        float c; float s = metal::sincos(x, c);
        return float2(c, s);
    }
    float2 sincos(float x)
    {
        float c; float s = metal::sincos(x, c);
        return float2(s, c);
    }
}

FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES bool _ci_early_out_nothing(uint2 gid, float4x4 transform)
{
    return false;
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES bool _ci_early_out_imageblock_nothing(uint2 gid, float4 outputRect)
{
    return false;
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES bool _ci_early_out(uint2 gid, float4x4 transform)
{
    return any(gid >= KERNEL_THREAD_COUNT(transform));
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES bool _ci_early_out_imageblock(uint2 gid, float4 outputRect)
{
    return !all(outputRect.xy <= static_cast<float2>(gid) && static_cast<float2>(gid) < outputRect.xy + abs(outputRect.zw));
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES float2 _ci_init_destcoord(uint2 gid, float4 outputRect, float4x4 transform)
{
    float2 dc = static_cast<float2>(gid) * KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform) + KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform)/2 + outputRect.xy;
    return _affineTransform(transform, dc) - KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform)/2 + 0.5;
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES float2 _ci_init_destcoord_imageblock(uint2 gid, float4 /*outputRect*/, float4x4 transform)
{
    float2 dc = static_cast<float2>(gid) * KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform) + KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform)/2;
    return _affineTransform(transform, dc) - KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform)/2 + 0.5;
}

FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES void _ci_writeSIMD_420 (coreimage::sample_t color, coreimage::priv::destination _dst)
{
    float2 p = static_cast<float2>(_dst.gid());
    // For each in every 2x2 cell, we write to the luminance plane
    _dst.write(color.rrrr, p);
    // The threadgroup size is hard-coded to 16x16 in MetalContext::render_node()
    // Instead we should use the option kCIKernelThreadsPerThreadgroup.
    // The 'simd_shuffle_down()' allows 'cc' to be read from other threads in the group.
    float2 cc = float2(color.gb);
    float2 ccSum;
    ccSum  = simd_shuffle_down(cc,  0);
    ccSum += simd_shuffle_down(cc,  1);
    ccSum += simd_shuffle_down(cc, 16);
    ccSum += simd_shuffle_down(cc, 17);
    // For once in every 2x2 cell, we write to the chroma plane
    const int x = int(p.x);
    const int y = int(p.y);
    if ((x % 2) == 0 && (y % 2) == 0)
        _dst.writePlane(ccSum.rgrg * 0.25, p / 2.0); 
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES void _ci_writeSIMD_422 (coreimage::sample_t color, coreimage::priv::destination _dst)
{
    float2 p = static_cast<float2>(_dst.gid());
    // For each in every 2x1 cell, we write to the luminance plane
    _dst.write(color.rrrr, p);
    // The threadgroup size is hard-coded to 16x16 in MetalContext::render_node()
    // Instead we should use the option kCIKernelThreadsPerThreadgroup.
    // The 'simd_shuffle_down()' allows 'cc' to be read from other threads in the group.
    float2 cc = float2(color.gb);
    float2 ccSum;
    ccSum  = simd_shuffle_down(cc,  0);
    ccSum += simd_shuffle_down(cc,  1);
    // For once in every 2x1 cell, we write to the chroma plane
    const int x = int(p.x);
    if ((x % 2) == 0)
        _dst.writePlane(ccSum.rgrg * 0.5, p / float2(2., 1.));
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES float4 _ci_writeSIMD_42X (coreimage::sample_t color, float4 shuffleMask, coreimage::priv::destination _dst)
{
    return color; // dummy return value
}
#define _CI_WRITETG_420_BODY_\
   /* The threadgroup size is hard-coded to 16x16 in MetalContext::render_node()
      Instead we should use the option kCIKernelThreadsPerThreadgroup.*/\
   const int grid = 16; \
   threadgroup float4 tgcc[grid * grid]; /* threadgroup array is initialized below */ \
    \
   const float2 py = static_cast<float2>(_dst.gid()); \
   const int x = int(py.x); \
   const int y = int(py.y); \
   const int index = ((y % grid) * grid) + (x % grid); \
   if (x % 2 == 0 && y % 2 == 0) \
   { \
       /* Initialize threadGroup memory */\
       tgcc[index]            = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
       tgcc[index + grid]     = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
       tgcc[index + 1]        = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
       tgcc[index + 1 + grid] = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
   } \
   /* Uses barriers to ensure order of read / write to threadgroup memory
      simdgroup_barrier are low overhead */\
   simdgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup); \
   tgcc[index] = float4(color.g, color.b, 1.0, 1.0); \
   simdgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup); \
    /* For once in every 2x2 cell, we write to the chroma plane */\
   if (x % 2 == 0 && y % 2 == 0) \
   { \
       /* Read from threadGroup memory*/\
       float4 ccvv = float4(tgcc[index]) \
                   + float4(tgcc[index + 1]) \
                   + float4(tgcc[index + grid]) \
                   + float4(tgcc[index + 1 + grid]); \
    \
        /* write subsampled output to chroma plane */\
       _dst.writePlane(ccvv.rgrg / ccvv.a, py / 2.0); \
   } \
    /* For each in every 2x2 cell, we write to the luminance plane */\
   _dst.write(color.rrrr, py);
#define _CI_WRITETG_422_BODY_\
    /* The threadgroup size is hard-coded to 16x16 in MetalContext::render_node()
      Instead we should use the option kCIKernelThreadsPerThreadgroup.*/ \
    const int grid = 16; \
    threadgroup float4 tgcc[grid * grid]; /* threadgroup array is initialized below */\
     \
    const float2 py = static_cast<float2>(_dst.gid()); \
    const int x = int(py.x); \
    const int y = int(py.y); \
    const int index = ((y % grid) * grid) + (x % grid); \
    if (x % 2 == 0 && y % 2 == 0) \
    { \
        /* Initialize threadGroup memory */\
        tgcc[index]            = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
        tgcc[index + grid]     = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
        tgcc[index + 1]        = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
        tgcc[index + 1 + grid] = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
    } \
     \
    /* Uses barriers to ensure order of read / write to threadgroup memory
       simdgroup_barrier are low overhead*/\
    simdgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup); \
    tgcc[index] = float4(color.g, color.b, 1.0, 1.0); \
    simdgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup); \
     \
    /*For once in every 2x1 cell, we write to the chroma plane*/\
    if (x % 2 == 0) \
    { \
        /* Read from threadGroup memory*/\
        float4 ccvv = float4(tgcc[index]) \
                    + float4(tgcc[index + 1]); \
     \
        /* write subsampled output to chroma plane */\
        _dst.writePlane(ccvv.rgrg / ccvv.a, py / float2(2., 1.)); \
    } \
     \
    /* For each in every 2x1 cell, we write to the luminance plane */\
    _dst.write(color.rrrr, py);

#define CI_ALWAYS_INLINE __attribute__((always_inline))
static float2 _affineTransform(float4x4 m, float2 p)
{
    return float2(dot(float3(p,1.0), m[0].xyz),
                  dot(float3(p,1.0), m[1].xyz));
}
#ifndef _BUILDING_CORE_IMAGE_LIB_ //[
template <typename T, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE T4 _read_pixel(texture2d<T, access::sample> image, sampler s, float2 p, float3x3 transform)
{
    float3 loc = float3(p, 1.0) * transform;
    return image.sample(s, loc.xy);
}
template <typename T, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE T4 _read_pixel_420(texture2d<T, access::sample> Y, sampler sY, float2 p, float3x3 transform,
                                    texture2d<T, access::sample> CC, sampler sCC, float2 f)
{
    float3 loc = float3(p, 1.0) * transform;
    return T4(Y.sample(sY, loc.xy).r, CC.sample(sCC, f*loc.xy).rg, 1.0);
}
template <typename T, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE T4 _read_pixel_420_r_rg(texture2d<T, access::sample> Y, sampler sY, float2 p, float3x3 transform,
                                         texture2d<T, access::sample> CC, sampler sCC, float2 f)
{
    float3 loc = float3(p, 1.0) * transform;
    return T4(Y.sample(sY, loc.xy).r, CC.sample(sCC, f*loc.xy).rg, 1.0);
}
// The biplanar packed 10-bit 420 format 'pf20' and 'p420' combine the horizontally neighboring luma
// values in one 32-bit word for the luma plane.  We bind this format at RGB10A2 as it aligns with how
// they do this.  This code is used to index and pull out the right value.  For the Chroma it is a bit
// more complex as three pairs of CrCb are packed into two 32-bit words and the second one straddles
// two samples.
//TODO check that a scaled image is getting the chroma correctly interpolated
//TODO handle the left and right edges for the chroma
template <typename T, typename T2, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE T4 _read_pixel_420_packed(texture2d<T, access::sample> Y,  sampler sY,  float2 c, float3x3 transform,
                                           texture2d<T, access::sample> CC, sampler sCC, float2 f)
{
    int cInt = int(c.x);
    int cInt2 = int(c.x*0.5);
    int lumaX = cInt/3;
    float3 pLuma = float3(lumaX+0.5, c.y, 1.0) * transform;
    int chromaX = (cInt2/3)*2;
    float3 pChromaM1 = float3(2.0*(chromaX - 0.5), c.y, 1.0) * transform;
    float3 pChroma1 = float3(2.0*(chromaX + 0.5), c.y, 1.0) * transform;
    float3 pChroma2 = float3(2.0*(chromaX + 1.5), c.y, 1.0) * transform;
    float3 pChroma3 = float3(2.0*(chromaX + 2.5), c.y, 1.0) * transform;
    T4 lumaGroup = Y.sample(sY, pLuma.xy);
    T4 chromaM1 = CC.sample(sCC, pChromaM1.xy * f);
    T4 chroma1 = CC.sample(sCC, pChroma1.xy * f);
    T4 chroma2 = CC.sample(sCC, pChroma2.xy * f);
    T4 chroma3 = CC.sample(sCC, pChroma3.xy * f);
    T2 crcbM1 = chromaM1.yx;
    T2 crcb0 = chroma1.zy;
    T2 crcb1 = T2(chroma1.x,chroma2.z);
    T2 crcb2 = chroma2.yx;
    T2 crcb3 = chroma3.zy;
    T4 out = T4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    int lumaRemainder = cInt - lumaX*3;
    out.x = (lumaRemainder==0) ? lumaGroup.z : (lumaRemainder==1) ? lumaGroup.y : lumaGroup.x;
    //Perform the chroma interpolation
    int chromaRemainder = cInt - (cInt/6)*6;  // dont use  % operator
    if (chromaRemainder == 0){
        out.yz = mix(crcbM1, crcb0, 0.75);
    } else if (chromaRemainder == 1) {
        out.yz = mix(crcb0, crcb1, 0.25);
    } else if (chromaRemainder == 2) {
        out.yz = mix(crcb0, crcb1, 0.75);
    } else if (chromaRemainder == 3) {
        out.yz = mix(crcb1, crcb2, 0.25);
    } else if (chromaRemainder == 4) {
        out.yz = mix(crcb1, crcb2, 0.75);
    } else if (chromaRemainder == 5) {
        out.yz = mix(crcb2, crcb3, 0.25);
    }
    return out;
}
#endif //] _BUILDING_CORE_IMAGE_LIB_
template <typename T, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE void _write_pixel(texture2d<T, access::write> outputTexture, const T4 result, const uint2 gid, const float4 outputRect)
{
    uint2 loc = gid + static_cast<uint2>(outputRect.xy);
    loc.y = loc.y + lessThan(outputRect.w, 0) * ((-outputRect.w-1)-2*gid.y); // for 'needsVerticalFlip'
    outputTexture.write(result, loc);
}
template <typename T, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE void _destinationWrite(texture2d<T, access::write> t, float4x4 m, float4 r, T4 v, float2 dc)
{
    const float2 p = _affineTransform(m, dc);
    const uint2 gid = static_cast<uint2>(p - r.xy); // assuming p >= r.xy
    if (all(gid < static_cast<uint2>(abs(r.zw))))
    {
        _write_pixel<T,T4>(t, v, gid, r);
    }
}

    static float4 _samplerExtent(float4x4 m)
    {
        return m[3]; // extent packed in last (unused) row of 4x4 transform matrix
    }
#ifdef __CIKERNEL_METAL_SUPPORTS_GATHER__ //[
    static half2 _gatherTransform(half2x2 m, half2 p)
    {
        return p * m + 0.5;
    }
    #define GATHER_COORD_TO_IDX(p) short(p.x + p.y * 2)
    template <typename T>
    static T _gatherOrdered(float4x4 m, T v)
    {
        // reorder samples into linear buffer based on Metal's specified order of gathered samples: v[0] v[1]
        v = v.wzxy; //                                                                              v[2] v[3]
        // reduce transform to orientation matrix for unit extent of [-0.5 -0.5 1 1], centered about the origin
        half2x2 orientation = half2x2(sign(m[0][0]),sign(m[0][1]),
                                      sign(m[1][0]),sign(m[1][1]));
        // transform gather coords based on sampler transform
        half2 p00 = _gatherTransform(orientation, half2(-0.5,-0.5));
        half2 p10 = _gatherTransform(orientation, half2( 0.5,-0.5));
        half2 p11 = _gatherTransform(orientation, half2( 0.5, 0.5));
        half2 p01 = _gatherTransform(orientation, half2(-0.5, 0.5));
        // convert gather coords to buffer indices, and return samples in CCW order starting w/ sample at the lower left
        return T(v[GATHER_COORD_TO_IDX(p00)],
                 v[GATHER_COORD_TO_IDX(p10)],
                 v[GATHER_COORD_TO_IDX(p11)],
                 v[GATHER_COORD_TO_IDX(p01)]);
    }
#endif //] __CIKERNEL_METAL_SUPPORTS_GATHER__

        // Writes 4 color values to the destination texture for the current 2x2 group of pixels.
        void destination::write(float4 v0, float4 v1, float4 v2, float4 v3)
        {
#if __CIKERNEL_SUPPORTS_VARIABLE_GROUPSIZE__
            float4x4 v = float4x4(v0, v1, v2, v3);
            for (short i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            {
                short dx = i % short(KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(m).x);
                short dy = i / short(KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(m).y);
                _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v[i], c + float2(dx,dy));
            }
#else
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v0, c);
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v1, c + float2(1,0));
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v2, c + float2(0,1));
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v3, c + float2(1,1));
#endif
        }
        // Writes 4 color values to the destination texture for the current 2x2 group of pixels.
        void destination_h::write(half4 v0, half4 v1, half4 v2, half4 v3)
        {
#if __CIKERNEL_SUPPORTS_VARIABLE_GROUPSIZE__
            half4x4 v = half4x4(v0, v1, v2, v3);
            for (short i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            {
                short dx = i % short(KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(m).x);
                short dy = i / short(KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(m).y);
                _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v[i], c + float2(dx,dy));
            }
#else
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v0, c);
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v1, c + float2(1,0));
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v2, c + float2(0,1));
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v3, c + float2(1,1));
#endif
        }

    float4 unpremultiply(float4 s) { return float4(s.xyz/ fmax(s.w, 0.00001), s.w); }
    half4 unpremultiply(half4 s) { return half4(s.xyz/ fmax(s.w, 0.0001h), s.w); }
    #define _srgb_to_linear(s,t) sign(s) * mix(abs(s)*0.077399380804954##t, pow(abs(s)*0.947867298578199##t + 0.052132701421801##t, 2.4##t), step(0.04045##t, abs(s)))
    float3 srgb_to_linear(float3 s) { return _srgb_to_linear(s, f); }
    half3 srgb_to_linear(half3 s) { return _srgb_to_linear(s, h); }
    float4 srgb_to_linear(float4 s)
    {
        s = float4(unpremultiply(s));
        s.rgb = _srgb_to_linear(s.rgb, f);
        return premultiply(s);
    }
    half4 srgb_to_linear(half4 s)
    {
        s = half4(unpremultiply(s));
        s.rgb = _srgb_to_linear(s.rgb, h);
        return premultiply(s);
    }
    #define _linear_to_srgb(s,t) sign(s) * mix(abs(s)*12.92##t, pow(abs(s), 0.4166667##t) * 1.055##t - 0.055##t, step(0.0031308##t, abs(s)))
    float3 linear_to_srgb(float3 s) { return _linear_to_srgb(s, f); }
    half3 linear_to_srgb(half3 s) { return _linear_to_srgb(s, h); }
    float4 linear_to_srgb(float4 s)
    {
      s = float4(unpremultiply(s));
      s.rgb = _linear_to_srgb(s.rgb, f);
      return premultiply(s);
    }
    half4 linear_to_srgb(half4 s)
    {
      s = half4(unpremultiply(s));
      s.rgb = _linear_to_srgb(s.rgb, h);
      return premultiply(s);
    }
    #define _compare(x,y,z) select(z, y, signbit(x)) // for each component, returns x < 0 ? y : z
    float  compare(float  x, float  y, float  z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    float2 compare(float2 x, float2 y, float2 z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    float3 compare(float3 x, float3 y, float3 z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    float4 compare(float4 x, float4 y, float4 z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    half   compare(half   x, half   y, half   z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    half2  compare(half2  x, half2  y, half2  z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    half3  compare(half3  x, half3  y, half3  z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    half4  compare(half4  x, half4  y, half4  z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    float2 cossin(float x)
    {
        float c; float s = metal::sincos(x, c);
        return float2(c, s);
    }
    float2 sincos(float x)
    {
        float c; float s = metal::sincos(x, c);
        return float2(s, c);
    }
}

FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES bool _ci_early_out_nothing(uint2 gid, float4x4 transform)
{
    return false;
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES bool _ci_early_out_imageblock_nothing(uint2 gid, float4 outputRect)
{
    return false;
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES bool _ci_early_out(uint2 gid, float4x4 transform)
{
    return any(gid >= KERNEL_THREAD_COUNT(transform));
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES bool _ci_early_out_imageblock(uint2 gid, float4 outputRect)
{
    return !all(outputRect.xy <= static_cast<float2>(gid) && static_cast<float2>(gid) < outputRect.xy + abs(outputRect.zw));
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES float2 _ci_init_destcoord(uint2 gid, float4 outputRect, float4x4 transform)
{
    float2 dc = static_cast<float2>(gid) * KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform) + KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform)/2 + outputRect.xy;
    return _affineTransform(transform, dc) - KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform)/2 + 0.5;
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES float2 _ci_init_destcoord_imageblock(uint2 gid, float4 /*outputRect*/, float4x4 transform)
{
    float2 dc = static_cast<float2>(gid) * KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform) + KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform)/2;
    return _affineTransform(transform, dc) - KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform)/2 + 0.5;
}

FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES void _ci_writeSIMD_420 (coreimage::sample_t color, coreimage::priv::destination _dst)
{
    float2 p = static_cast<float2>(_dst.gid());
    // For each in every 2x2 cell, we write to the luminance plane
    _dst.write(color.rrrr, p);
    // The threadgroup size is hard-coded to 16x16 in MetalContext::render_node()
    // Instead we should use the option kCIKernelThreadsPerThreadgroup.
    // The 'simd_shuffle_down()' allows 'cc' to be read from other threads in the group.
    float2 cc = float2(color.gb);
    float2 ccSum;
    ccSum  = simd_shuffle_down(cc,  0);
    ccSum += simd_shuffle_down(cc,  1);
    ccSum += simd_shuffle_down(cc, 16);
    ccSum += simd_shuffle_down(cc, 17);
    // For once in every 2x2 cell, we write to the chroma plane
    const int x = int(p.x);
    const int y = int(p.y);
    if ((x % 2) == 0 && (y % 2) == 0)
        _dst.writePlane(ccSum.rgrg * 0.25, p / 2.0); 
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES void _ci_writeSIMD_422 (coreimage::sample_t color, coreimage::priv::destination _dst)
{
    float2 p = static_cast<float2>(_dst.gid());
    // For each in every 2x1 cell, we write to the luminance plane
    _dst.write(color.rrrr, p);
    // The threadgroup size is hard-coded to 16x16 in MetalContext::render_node()
    // Instead we should use the option kCIKernelThreadsPerThreadgroup.
    // The 'simd_shuffle_down()' allows 'cc' to be read from other threads in the group.
    float2 cc = float2(color.gb);
    float2 ccSum;
    ccSum  = simd_shuffle_down(cc,  0);
    ccSum += simd_shuffle_down(cc,  1);
    // For once in every 2x1 cell, we write to the chroma plane
    const int x = int(p.x);
    if ((x % 2) == 0)
        _dst.writePlane(ccSum.rgrg * 0.5, p / float2(2., 1.));
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES float4 _ci_writeSIMD_42X (coreimage::sample_t color, float4 shuffleMask, coreimage::priv::destination _dst)
{
    return color; // dummy return value
}
#define _CI_WRITETG_420_BODY_\
   /* The threadgroup size is hard-coded to 16x16 in MetalContext::render_node()
      Instead we should use the option kCIKernelThreadsPerThreadgroup.*/\
   const int grid = 16; \
   threadgroup float4 tgcc[grid * grid]; /* threadgroup array is initialized below */ \
    \
   const float2 py = static_cast<float2>(_dst.gid()); \
   const int x = int(py.x); \
   const int y = int(py.y); \
   const int index = ((y % grid) * grid) + (x % grid); \
   if (x % 2 == 0 && y % 2 == 0) \
   { \
       /* Initialize threadGroup memory */\
       tgcc[index]            = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
       tgcc[index + grid]     = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
       tgcc[index + 1]        = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
       tgcc[index + 1 + grid] = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
   } \
   /* Uses barriers to ensure order of read / write to threadgroup memory
      simdgroup_barrier are low overhead */\
   simdgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup); \
   tgcc[index] = float4(color.g, color.b, 1.0, 1.0); \
   simdgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup); \
    /* For once in every 2x2 cell, we write to the chroma plane */\
   if (x % 2 == 0 && y % 2 == 0) \
   { \
       /* Read from threadGroup memory*/\
       float4 ccvv = float4(tgcc[index]) \
                   + float4(tgcc[index + 1]) \
                   + float4(tgcc[index + grid]) \
                   + float4(tgcc[index + 1 + grid]); \
    \
        /* write subsampled output to chroma plane */\
       _dst.writePlane(ccvv.rgrg / ccvv.a, py / 2.0); \
   } \
    /* For each in every 2x2 cell, we write to the luminance plane */\
   _dst.write(color.rrrr, py);
#define _CI_WRITETG_422_BODY_\
    /* The threadgroup size is hard-coded to 16x16 in MetalContext::render_node()
      Instead we should use the option kCIKernelThreadsPerThreadgroup.*/ \
    const int grid = 16; \
    threadgroup float4 tgcc[grid * grid]; /* threadgroup array is initialized below */\
     \
    const float2 py = static_cast<float2>(_dst.gid()); \
    const int x = int(py.x); \
    const int y = int(py.y); \
    const int index = ((y % grid) * grid) + (x % grid); \
    if (x % 2 == 0 && y % 2 == 0) \
    { \
        /* Initialize threadGroup memory */\
        tgcc[index]            = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
        tgcc[index + grid]     = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
        tgcc[index + 1]        = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
        tgcc[index + 1 + grid] = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
    } \
     \
    /* Uses barriers to ensure order of read / write to threadgroup memory
       simdgroup_barrier are low overhead*/\
    simdgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup); \
    tgcc[index] = float4(color.g, color.b, 1.0, 1.0); \
    simdgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup); \
     \
    /*For once in every 2x1 cell, we write to the chroma plane*/\
    if (x % 2 == 0) \
    { \
        /* Read from threadGroup memory*/\
        float4 ccvv = float4(tgcc[index]) \
                    + float4(tgcc[index + 1]); \
     \
        /* write subsampled output to chroma plane */\
        _dst.writePlane(ccvv.rgrg / ccvv.a, py / float2(2., 1.)); \
    } \
     \
    /* For each in every 2x1 cell, we write to the luminance plane */\
    _dst.write(color.rrrr, py);

#define CI_ALWAYS_INLINE __attribute__((always_inline))
static float2 _affineTransform(float4x4 m, float2 p)
{
    return float2(dot(float3(p,1.0), m[0].xyz),
                  dot(float3(p,1.0), m[1].xyz));
}
#ifndef _BUILDING_CORE_IMAGE_LIB_ //[
template <typename T, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE T4 _read_pixel(texture2d<T, access::sample> image, sampler s, float2 p, float3x3 transform)
{
    float3 loc = float3(p, 1.0) * transform;
    return image.sample(s, loc.xy);
}
template <typename T, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE T4 _read_pixel_420(texture2d<T, access::sample> Y, sampler sY, float2 p, float3x3 transform,
                                    texture2d<T, access::sample> CC, sampler sCC, float2 f)
{
    float3 loc = float3(p, 1.0) * transform;
    return T4(Y.sample(sY, loc.xy).r, CC.sample(sCC, f*loc.xy).rg, 1.0);
}
template <typename T, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE T4 _read_pixel_420_r_rg(texture2d<T, access::sample> Y, sampler sY, float2 p, float3x3 transform,
                                         texture2d<T, access::sample> CC, sampler sCC, float2 f)
{
    float3 loc = float3(p, 1.0) * transform;
    return T4(Y.sample(sY, loc.xy).r, CC.sample(sCC, f*loc.xy).rg, 1.0);
}
// The biplanar packed 10-bit 420 format 'pf20' and 'p420' combine the horizontally neighboring luma
// values in one 32-bit word for the luma plane.  We bind this format at RGB10A2 as it aligns with how
// they do this.  This code is used to index and pull out the right value.  For the Chroma it is a bit
// more complex as three pairs of CrCb are packed into two 32-bit words and the second one straddles
// two samples.
//TODO check that a scaled image is getting the chroma correctly interpolated
//TODO handle the left and right edges for the chroma
template <typename T, typename T2, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE T4 _read_pixel_420_packed(texture2d<T, access::sample> Y,  sampler sY,  float2 c, float3x3 transform,
                                           texture2d<T, access::sample> CC, sampler sCC, float2 f)
{
    int cInt = int(c.x);
    int cInt2 = int(c.x*0.5);
    int lumaX = cInt/3;
    float3 pLuma = float3(lumaX+0.5, c.y, 1.0) * transform;
    int chromaX = (cInt2/3)*2;
    float3 pChromaM1 = float3(2.0*(chromaX - 0.5), c.y, 1.0) * transform;
    float3 pChroma1 = float3(2.0*(chromaX + 0.5), c.y, 1.0) * transform;
    float3 pChroma2 = float3(2.0*(chromaX + 1.5), c.y, 1.0) * transform;
    float3 pChroma3 = float3(2.0*(chromaX + 2.5), c.y, 1.0) * transform;
    T4 lumaGroup = Y.sample(sY, pLuma.xy);
    T4 chromaM1 = CC.sample(sCC, pChromaM1.xy * f);
    T4 chroma1 = CC.sample(sCC, pChroma1.xy * f);
    T4 chroma2 = CC.sample(sCC, pChroma2.xy * f);
    T4 chroma3 = CC.sample(sCC, pChroma3.xy * f);
    T2 crcbM1 = chromaM1.yx;
    T2 crcb0 = chroma1.zy;
    T2 crcb1 = T2(chroma1.x,chroma2.z);
    T2 crcb2 = chroma2.yx;
    T2 crcb3 = chroma3.zy;
    T4 out = T4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    int lumaRemainder = cInt - lumaX*3;
    out.x = (lumaRemainder==0) ? lumaGroup.z : (lumaRemainder==1) ? lumaGroup.y : lumaGroup.x;
    //Perform the chroma interpolation
    int chromaRemainder = cInt - (cInt/6)*6;  // dont use  % operator
    if (chromaRemainder == 0){
        out.yz = mix(crcbM1, crcb0, 0.75);
    } else if (chromaRemainder == 1) {
        out.yz = mix(crcb0, crcb1, 0.25);
    } else if (chromaRemainder == 2) {
        out.yz = mix(crcb0, crcb1, 0.75);
    } else if (chromaRemainder == 3) {
        out.yz = mix(crcb1, crcb2, 0.25);
    } else if (chromaRemainder == 4) {
        out.yz = mix(crcb1, crcb2, 0.75);
    } else if (chromaRemainder == 5) {
        out.yz = mix(crcb2, crcb3, 0.25);
    }
    return out;
}
#endif //] _BUILDING_CORE_IMAGE_LIB_
template <typename T, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE void _write_pixel(texture2d<T, access::write> outputTexture, const T4 result, const uint2 gid, const float4 outputRect)
{
    uint2 loc = gid + static_cast<uint2>(outputRect.xy);
    loc.y = loc.y + lessThan(outputRect.w, 0) * ((-outputRect.w-1)-2*gid.y); // for 'needsVerticalFlip'
    outputTexture.write(result, loc);
}
template <typename T, typename T4>
CI_ALWAYS_INLINE void _destinationWrite(texture2d<T, access::write> t, float4x4 m, float4 r, T4 v, float2 dc)
{
    const float2 p = _affineTransform(m, dc);
    const uint2 gid = static_cast<uint2>(p - r.xy); // assuming p >= r.xy
    if (all(gid < static_cast<uint2>(abs(r.zw))))
    {
        _write_pixel<T,T4>(t, v, gid, r);
    }
}

    static float4 _samplerExtent(float4x4 m)
    {
        return m[3]; // extent packed in last (unused) row of 4x4 transform matrix
    }
#ifdef __CIKERNEL_METAL_SUPPORTS_GATHER__ //[
    static half2 _gatherTransform(half2x2 m, half2 p)
    {
        return p * m + 0.5;
    }
    #define GATHER_COORD_TO_IDX(p) short(p.x + p.y * 2)
    template <typename T>
    static T _gatherOrdered(float4x4 m, T v)
    {
        // reorder samples into linear buffer based on Metal's specified order of gathered samples: v[0] v[1]
        v = v.wzxy; //                                                                              v[2] v[3]
        // reduce transform to orientation matrix for unit extent of [-0.5 -0.5 1 1], centered about the origin
        half2x2 orientation = half2x2(sign(m[0][0]),sign(m[0][1]),
                                      sign(m[1][0]),sign(m[1][1]));
        // transform gather coords based on sampler transform
        half2 p00 = _gatherTransform(orientation, half2(-0.5,-0.5));
        half2 p10 = _gatherTransform(orientation, half2( 0.5,-0.5));
        half2 p11 = _gatherTransform(orientation, half2( 0.5, 0.5));
        half2 p01 = _gatherTransform(orientation, half2(-0.5, 0.5));
        // convert gather coords to buffer indices, and return samples in CCW order starting w/ sample at the lower left
        return T(v[GATHER_COORD_TO_IDX(p00)],
                 v[GATHER_COORD_TO_IDX(p10)],
                 v[GATHER_COORD_TO_IDX(p11)],
                 v[GATHER_COORD_TO_IDX(p01)]);
    }
#endif //] __CIKERNEL_METAL_SUPPORTS_GATHER__

    namespace group
    {
        // Writes 4 color values to the destination texture for the current 2x2 group of pixels.
        void destination::write(float4 v0, float4 v1, float4 v2, float4 v3)
        {
#if __CIKERNEL_SUPPORTS_VARIABLE_GROUPSIZE__
            float4x4 v = float4x4(v0, v1, v2, v3);
            for (short i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            {
                short dx = i % short(KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(m).x);
                short dy = i / short(KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(m).y);
                _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v[i], c + float2(dx,dy));
            }
#else
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v0, c);
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v1, c + float2(1,0));
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v2, c + float2(0,1));
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v3, c + float2(1,1));
#endif
        }
        // Writes 4 color values to the destination texture for the current 2x2 group of pixels.
        void destination_h::write(half4 v0, half4 v1, half4 v2, half4 v3)
        {
#if __CIKERNEL_SUPPORTS_VARIABLE_GROUPSIZE__
            half4x4 v = half4x4(v0, v1, v2, v3);
            for (short i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            {
                short dx = i % short(KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(m).x);
                short dy = i / short(KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(m).y);
                _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v[i], c + float2(dx,dy));
            }
#else
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v0, c);
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v1, c + float2(1,0));
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v2, c + float2(0,1));
            _destinationWrite(t, m, r, v3, c + float2(1,1));
#endif
        }
    }
#pragma mark - math
    float4 premultiply(float4 s) { return float4(s.xyz* s.w, s.w); }
    half4 premultiply(half4 s) { return half4(s.xyz* s.w, s.w); }
    float4 unpremultiply(float4 s) { return float4(s.xyz/ fmax(s.w, 0.00001), s.w); }
    half4 unpremultiply(half4 s) { return half4(s.xyz/ fmax(s.w, 0.0001h), s.w); }
    #define _srgb_to_linear(s,t) sign(s) * mix(abs(s)*0.077399380804954##t, pow(abs(s)*0.947867298578199##t + 0.052132701421801##t, 2.4##t), step(0.04045##t, abs(s)))
    float3 srgb_to_linear(float3 s) { return _srgb_to_linear(s, f); }
    half3 srgb_to_linear(half3 s) { return _srgb_to_linear(s, h); }
    float4 srgb_to_linear(float4 s)
    {
        s = float4(unpremultiply(s));
        s.rgb = _srgb_to_linear(s.rgb, f);
        return premultiply(s);
    }
    half4 srgb_to_linear(half4 s)
    {
        s = half4(unpremultiply(s));
        s.rgb = _srgb_to_linear(s.rgb, h);
        return premultiply(s);
    }
    #define _linear_to_srgb(s,t) sign(s) * mix(abs(s)*12.92##t, pow(abs(s), 0.4166667##t) * 1.055##t - 0.055##t, step(0.0031308##t, abs(s)))
    float3 linear_to_srgb(float3 s) { return _linear_to_srgb(s, f); }
    half3 linear_to_srgb(half3 s) { return _linear_to_srgb(s, h); }
    float4 linear_to_srgb(float4 s)
    {
      s = float4(unpremultiply(s));
      s.rgb = _linear_to_srgb(s.rgb, f);
      return premultiply(s);
    }
    half4 linear_to_srgb(half4 s)
    {
      s = half4(unpremultiply(s));
      s.rgb = _linear_to_srgb(s.rgb, h);
      return premultiply(s);
    }
    #define _compare(x,y,z) select(z, y, signbit(x)) // for each component, returns x < 0 ? y : z
    float  compare(float  x, float  y, float  z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    float2 compare(float2 x, float2 y, float2 z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    float3 compare(float3 x, float3 y, float3 z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    float4 compare(float4 x, float4 y, float4 z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    half   compare(half   x, half   y, half   z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    half2  compare(half2  x, half2  y, half2  z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    half3  compare(half3  x, half3  y, half3  z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    half4  compare(half4  x, half4  y, half4  z) { return _compare(x, y, z); }
    float2 cossin(float x)
    {
        float c; float s = metal::sincos(x, c);
        return float2(c, s);
    }
    float2 sincos(float x)
    {
        float c; float s = metal::sincos(x, c);
        return float2(s, c);
    }
}

FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES bool _ci_early_out_nothing(uint2 gid, float4x4 transform)
{
    return false;

FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES bool _ci_early_out_imageblock_nothing(uint2 gid, float4 outputRect)
{
    return false;
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES bool _ci_early_out(uint2 gid, float4x4 transform)
{
    return any(gid >= KERNEL_THREAD_COUNT(transform));
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES bool _ci_early_out_imageblock(uint2 gid, float4 outputRect)
{
    return !all(outputRect.xy <= static_cast<float2>(gid) && static_cast<float2>(gid) < outputRect.xy + abs(outputRect.zw));
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES float2 _ci_init_destcoord(uint2 gid, float4 outputRect, float4x4 transform)
{
    float2 dc = static_cast<float2>(gid) * KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform) + KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform)/2 + outputRect.xy;
    return _affineTransform(transform, dc) - KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform)/2 + 0.5;
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES float2 _ci_init_destcoord_imageblock(uint2 gid, float4 /*outputRect*/, float4x4 transform)
{
    float2 dc = static_cast<float2>(gid) * KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform) + KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform)/2;
    return _affineTransform(transform, dc) - KERNEL_OUTPUT_SIZE(transform)/2 + 0.5;
}

FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES void _ci_writeSIMD_420 (coreimage::sample_t color, coreimage::priv::destination _dst)
{
    float2 p = static_cast<float2>(_dst.gid());
    // For each in every 2x2 cell, we write to the luminance plane
    _dst.write(color.rrrr, p);
    // The threadgroup size is hard-coded to 16x16 in MetalContext::render_node()
    // Instead we should use the option kCIKernelThreadsPerThreadgroup.
    // The 'simd_shuffle_down()' allows 'cc' to be read from other threads in the group.
    float2 cc = float2(color.gb);
    float2 ccSum;
    ccSum  = simd_shuffle_down(cc,  0);
    ccSum += simd_shuffle_down(cc,  1);
    ccSum += simd_shuffle_down(cc, 16);
    ccSum += simd_shuffle_down(cc, 17);
    // For once in every 2x2 cell, we write to the chroma plane
    const int x = int(p.x);
    const int y = int(p.y);
    if ((x % 2) == 0 && (y % 2) == 0)
        _dst.writePlane(ccSum.rgrg * 0.25, p / 2.0); 
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES void _ci_writeSIMD_422 (coreimage::sample_t color, coreimage::priv::destination _dst)
{
    float2 p = static_cast<float2>(_dst.gid());
    // For each in every 2x1 cell, we write to the luminance plane
    _dst.write(color.rrrr, p);
    // The threadgroup size is hard-coded to 16x16 in MetalContext::render_node()
    // Instead we should use the option kCIKernelThreadsPerThreadgroup.
    // The 'simd_shuffle_down()' allows 'cc' to be read from other threads in the group.
    float2 cc = float2(color.gb);
    float2 ccSum;
    ccSum  = simd_shuffle_down(cc,  0);
    ccSum += simd_shuffle_down(cc,  1);
    // For once in every 2x1 cell, we write to the chroma plane
    const int x = int(p.x);
    if ((x % 2) == 0)
        _dst.writePlane(ccSum.rgrg * 0.5, p / float2(2., 1.));
}
FUNCTION_ATTRIBUTES float4 _ci_writeSIMD_42X (coreimage::sample_t color, float4 shuffleMask, coreimage::priv::destination _dst)
{
    return color; // dummy return value
}
#define _CI_WRITETG_420_BODY_\
   /* The threadgroup size is hard-coded to 16x16 in MetalContext::render_node()
      Instead we should use the option kCIKernelThreadsPerThreadgroup.*/\
   const int grid = 16; \
   threadgroup float4 tgcc[grid * grid]; /* threadgroup array is initialized below */ \
    \
   const float2 py = static_cast<float2>(_dst.gid()); \
   const int x = int(py.x); \
   const int y = int(py.y); \
   const int index = ((y % grid) * grid) + (x % grid); \
   if (x % 2 == 0 && y % 2 == 0) \
   { \
       /* Initialize threadGroup memory */\
       tgcc[index]            = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
       tgcc[index + grid]     = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
       tgcc[index + 1]        = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
       tgcc[index + 1 + grid] = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
   } \
   /* Uses barriers to ensure order of read / write to threadgroup memory
      simdgroup_barrier are low overhead */\
   simdgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup); \
   tgcc[index] = float4(color.g, color.b, 1.0, 1.0); \
   simdgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup); \
    /* For once in every 2x2 cell, we write to the chroma plane */\
   if (x % 2 == 0 && y % 2 == 0) \
   { \
       /* Read from threadGroup memory*/\
       float4 ccvv = float4(tgcc[index]) \
                   + float4(tgcc[index + 1]) \
                   + float4(tgcc[index + grid]) \
                   + float4(tgcc[index + 1 + grid]); \
    \
        /* write subsampled output to chroma plane */\
       _dst.writePlane(ccvv.rgrg / ccvv.a, py / 2.0); \
   } \
    /* For each in every 2x2 cell, we write to the luminance plane */\
   _dst.write(color.rrrr, py);
#define _CI_WRITETG_422_BODY_\
    /* The threadgroup size is hard-coded to 16x16 in MetalContext::render_node()
      Instead we should use the option kCIKernelThreadsPerThreadgroup.*/ \
    const int grid = 16; \
    threadgroup float4 tgcc[grid * grid]; /* threadgroup array is initialized below */\
     \
    const float2 py = static_cast<float2>(_dst.gid()); \
    const int x = int(py.x); \
    const int y = int(py.y); \
    const int index = ((y % grid) * grid) + (x % grid); \
    if (x % 2 == 0 && y % 2 == 0) \
    { \
        /* Initialize threadGroup memory */\
        tgcc[index]            = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
        tgcc[index + grid]     = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
        tgcc[index + 1]        = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
        tgcc[index + 1 + grid] = float4(0., 0., 0., 0.); \
    } \
     \
    /* Uses barriers to ensure order of read / write to threadgroup memory
       simdgroup_barrier are low overhead*/\
    simdgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup); \
    tgcc[index] = float4(color.g, color.b, 1.0, 1.0); \
    simdgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup); \
     \
    /*For once in every 2x1 cell, we write to the chroma plane*/\
    if (x % 2 == 0) \
    { \
        /* Read from threadGroup memory*/\
        float4 ccvv = float4(tgcc[index]) \
                    + float4(tgcc[index + 1]); \
     \
        /* write subsampled output to chroma plane */\
        _dst.writePlane(ccvv.rgrg / ccvv.a, py / float2(2., 1.)); \
    } \
     \
    /* For each in every 2x1 cell, we write to the luminance plane */\
    _dst.write(color.rrrr, py);

  c.rgb = clamp(c.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
  vec3 m = 1.0 - c.rgb;
  float a = 6.000000e-01;
  vec4 result = c;
  result.rgb = 1.0 - (pow(m, vec3(gamma)) + (a * ((((gamma - 1.0) * m) * (1.0 - (m * m))) / (gamma * gamma))));
  c.rgb = pow(c.rgb, vec3(1.0 - ((min(gamma, 2.950) - 1.0) / 2.600)));
  result.rgb = mix(c.rgb, result.rgb, 8.500000e-01);
  result.rgb = (result.rgb + neg) + pos;
  return result;
}

  float rgb_max_tmo = slope_adjusted * rgb_max;
  if (rgb_max > p0x) {
    float a = bezier_norm.x;
    float b = bezier_norm.y;
    float c = bezier_norm.z;
    float t = (sqrt(max((a * rgb_max) + b, 0.0)) + c) / a;
    float p0y = beziers_py.x;
    float p1y = beziers_py.y;
    float p2y = beziers_py.z;
    float yB = ((((1.0 - t) * (1.0 - t)) * p0y) + (((2 * (1.0 - t)) * t) * p1y)) + ((t * t) * p2y);
    float extension_offset = extension.y;
    rgb_max_tmo = (rgb_max < source_headroom) ? yB : extension_offset;
  }
  float output_gamma = extension.z;
  rgb_max_tmo = pow(rgb_max_tmo / target_headroom, output_gamma) * target_headroom;
  float maxRatio = min(rgb_max_tmo / rgb_max, 1.0);
  vec3 img_tmo = min(maxRatio * img.rgb, target_headroom);
  return vec4(img_tmo, img.a);

  float m = 3.700000e+01;
  float n = x;
  n = mod((y * n) + y, m);
  n = mod((y * n) + x, m);
  n = mod(x * n, m);
  n = mod(x * n, m);
  return n / m;
}
kernel vec4 _hsvwheeldithered(vec4 params, float dither) {
  float value = params.x;
  float radius = params.y;
  float invradius = params.z;
  float smoothness = params.w;
  vec2 p = destCoord() - vec2(radius);
  float len = length(p);
  float H = (atan(p.y, p.x) * 3.0) / 3.141593e+00;
  H = (p.x == 0.0) ? ((p.y > 0.0) ? 1.500 : (-1.500)) : H;
  float S = clamp(len * invradius, 0.0, 1.0);
  vec4 c = vec4(H, H - 2.0, H + 2.0, 0.0);
  c = clamp(abs(3.0 - abs(c)) - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);
  c = mix(c, smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, c), smoothness);
  c = mix(vec4(1.0), c, S);
  c.a = 1.0;
  c.rgb *= value;
  c.rgb += (__noise(0.0, floor(destCoord())) - 0.5) * dither;
  return c * clamp(radius - len, 0.0, 1.0);
}

    sow+= w; sowd+= w * d;
    p = sample(yuv1,      samplerTransform(yuv1,      gidHalf + vec2( 0.0, 0.0)));
    d = sample(inDispMap, samplerTransform(inDispMap, gidHalf + vec2( 0.0, 0.0))).r;
    w = _local_yuvWeight(ref, p, sigmaLCRecip);
    sow+= w; sowd+= w * d;
    float alt = d;
    p = sample(yuv1,      samplerTransform(yuv1,      gidHalf + vec2( 1.0, 0.0)));
    d = sample(inDispMap, samplerTransform(inDispMap, gidHalf + vec2( 1.0, 0.0))).r;
    w = _local_yuvWeight(ref, p, sigmaLCRecip);
    sow+= w; sowd+= w * d;
    p = sample(yuv1,      samplerTransform(yuv1,      gidHalf + vec2(-1.0, 1.0)));
    d = sample(inDispMap, samplerTransform(inDispMap, gidHalf + vec2(-1.0, 1.0))).r;
    w = _local_yuvWeight(ref, p, sigmaLCRecip);
    sow+= w; sowd+= w * d;
    p = sample(yuv1,      samplerTransform(yuv1,      gidHalf + vec2( 0.0, 1.0)));
    d = sample(inDispMap, samplerTransform(inDispMap, gidHalf + vec2( 0.0, 1.0))).r;
    w = _local_yuvWeight(ref, p, sigmaLCRecip);
    sow+= w; sowd+= w * d;
    p = sample(yuv1,      samplerTransform(yuv1,      gidHalf + vec2( 1.0, 1.0)));
    d = sample(inDispMap, samplerTransform(inDispMap, gidHalf + vec2( 1.0, 1.0))).r;
    w = _local_yuvWeight(ref, p, sigmaLCRecip);
    sow+= w; sowd+= w * d;
    float rc = (sow < pmws) ? alt : (sowd / sow);
	
	return vec4(rc,rc,rc,1.0);
}

  k = clamp(k, 0.0, 1.0);
  float m = k * maxBlur;
  m = log2((m * 4.0) / 3.0);
  m = max(m, 0.0);
  float mLo = floor(m);
  vec4 c0 = sample(s0, samplerTransform(s0, dc));

  vec4 cLo = c0;

  cHi = (mLo > 0.5) ? c2 : cHi;
  cLo = (mLo > 1.500) ? c2 : cLo;

  cLo = (mLo > 4.500) ? c5 : cLo;
  cHi = (mLo > 4.500) ? c6 : cHi;
  cLo = (mLo > 5.500) ? c6 : cLo;
